product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Wood and Iron Rectangular Hanging Wall Mirror, 44.25 Inch Height, Brown and Black
product.description: This modern mirror artfully combines wood and iron to form a frame with hints of classic and industrial style. The natural color of the wide rubber wood plank paired with narrow black iron trim makes it a striking addition to any room. Classic, modern and industrial touches help it blend anywhere Glass, solid rubber wood and iron with black finish 13.5"W x 1.75"D x 44.25"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
